sharedRules.name: Drones
sharedRules.description:
Place a Drone token marker.
If this unit has the Guardian Drone wargear, against ranged attacks, subtract 1 from the attacking unit's Wound rolls.
If this unit has the Gun Drone wargear, this model gains 1 Twin Pulse Carbine weapon.
If this unit has the Marker Drone wargear, this unit gains the MARKERLIGHT keyword.
If this unit has the Marker Drone wargear, this unit is eligible to act as an Observer even if it Advanced this turn.
If this unit has the Missile Drone wargear, this model gains 1 Missile Pod weapon.
If this unit has the Shield Drone wargear, add 1 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

sharedRules.name: For the Greater Good
sharedRules.description:
At the start of your Shooting phase, you can use this ability, if your Army Faction is TAU EMPIRE:
  - Select one or more friendly units with the For the Greater Good ability. Those units are an Observer.
  - Until the end of the phase, during your Shooting phase, for each friendly unit that is Observers: select one enemy unit that is not Spotted and visible to this unit; unless this unit has been selected to shoot this phase, if this unit is eligible to shoot (excluding Fortification units), while this unit is not Battle-shocked, that unit is Spotted by that unit until the end of the phase; if the attacking unit is Guided, while the target is Spotted, improve friendly models' Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1; if the attacking unit is Guided, while the target is Spotted and the target is Spotted by a friendly MARKERLIGHT unit that is an Observer, friendly models' weapons gain [IGNORES COVER].
